QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Future of the Forest
QuestInfo.1: It seems Athena Pierce was close to Ephenia. Give her time to pull herself together and talk to her again.
QuestInfo.2:
To set Athena Pierce at ease about the future of the forest, you told her that a town called #bEllinia#k will be formed here in the future.
But she said she won't hear anymore as they want to create the future of this place with their own strength.
